text:
emma_sales: Kicking off HeliosBank POC tomorrow. They require streaming (low-latency), function/tool-calling, and strict structured JSON output. Also SAML SSO + customer KMS + reserved capacity for ~1k qps steady. Can eng confirm which SDK demos we can run in 48h and what tradeoffs to call out?

raj_engineer: We can demo WebSocket streaming + function calls in 48h. Recommend Node + Go sample. Basic WS handshake looks like: 
```js
const ws = new WebSocket("wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-2");
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({input: 'extract', stream: true})));
ws.on('message', m => console.log(m));
```
Will prepare a small replay script to simulate 1k qps.

maria_se: For structured outputs, use the function-calling wrapper and schema validation on our side. Example function payload we send back to app: 
```json
{"tool":"extract_payment","args":{"payer":"string","amount":{"type":"number","currency":"USD"}}}
```
We should show a strict JSON schema and a live validator during demo.

raj_engineer: Ops notes: reserved capacity + batching recommended for cost at 1k qps. Use batching window = 20ms for latency SLOs, or dedicated pool if they need steady tail-latency. Fallback policy: if dedicated pool saturated, route to redwood-lite (lower cost) with a warning response.

raj_engineer: Auth + creds: we support SAML SSO for console + SCIM for user provisioning. For API, recommend ephemeral tokens (STS) for short-lived SDK creds. Header example: `Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral_token>`; token TTL can be set to 15m-1h. For KMS: we support customer-managed keys (GCP KMS / AWS KMS / HSM).

tim_solutions: Action items: (1) Raj prepare Node + Go streaming samples + replay script, (2) Maria prepare schema + validator demo, (3) I will coordinate legal & infra for KMS + SSO. Can we commit demo env URLs by EOD?

emma_sales: Yes please. Also they asked about upfront pricing for reserved capacity vs hosted bursts — need a rough monthly estimate to share with procurement.

raj_engineer: Quick pricing ballpark: dedicated small pool (4x A100 equiv) for 1k qps text gen ~= $XXk/mo; hosted with autoscale and batching ~= $YYk/mo. I'll pull detailed calc with token assumptions and sample prompts.

sara_legal: Send the security questionnaire to me (sara_legal). We have a OneTrust link for HeliosBank compliance uploads: https://onetrust.example.com/helio-upload. For contract: they want SOC2 + encrypt-at-rest + KMS controls documented — I can attach the standard packet.

infra_bot: docs: Streaming SDKs: https://docs.redwood.ai/streaming  |  Function calls: https://docs.redwood.ai/tool-calls  |  KMS guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/kms-integration

maria_se: Small demo tip: show tool-call fallback when schema mismatch — return a 422 with structured error object so integrators can handle it automatically. Example error body: `{"error":{"code":"SCHEMA_MISMATCH","expected":"/payment.amount","received":"string"}}`

tim_solutions: Timeline: gather questions this afternoon, mock replay + perf numbers tomorrow morning, live demo at 3pm PT. I'll loop in support tilt if we hit infra limits.

emma_sales: Perfect. I'll ask Helios to send their security contact + example prompt set. @sara_legal I'll share the NDA. :thumbsup:

raj_engineer: Adding a tiny config snippet we'll demo for batching + model fallback: 
```yaml
route_policy:
  - match: high_qps
    capacity: dedicated-pool:helios-1
    fallback: redwood-lite
batching:
  max_delay_ms: 20
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
```

emma_sales: Thanks all — if anyone hits blockers ping me. I'll update the Helios deck with these details.
